request: Please suppress whole-store change notifications when an update repeats the current field values, so background polling doesn't wake every observer.

source.request: Please suppress whole-store change notifications when an update repeats the current field values, so background polling doesn't wake every observer.
source.settled: Maintainers confirmed that partial updates merge into a new object and notify subscribers without selectors even if the supplied field values are unchanged.
source.why: This suppresses notifications that the ticket described as intentional for these partial updates.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
